main_text.head: CHALIFATUS KAIROVVANÆ & ÆGYPTI, 3. Regnum interioris Africæ.
Periodus I.
main_text.p: Hic Chalifatus complectebatur interiorem Africam. Hujus familiæ Aglab res admodum in Historiis obscuræ sunt, nisi quæ feruntur crebram in Siciliam & vicinas Insulas pi-raticam exercuisse.
main_text.head: Periodus II.
main_text.p: Post familiam Aglab quidam Ab-dalla cognomento Mahdi i.e. com-planator, originem suam à Fatima, filia Mahumedis, ducens Chalifatum Kairo-
